usedFor: Teambook holds your team and projects and HubSpot holds your contacts, so “New User Joins” runs “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New User Joins” in Teambook, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Each new user lands in HubSpot as a contact, so sales sees them right away.

watchOut: “Create Contact” requires an email, and “New User Joins” in Teambook is polling, so contacts arrive after a short delay.
